name: Phoenix Mills Ltd.
business_summary: India's leading mall owner-operator (Phoenix Marketcity in Mumbai/Pune/Bengaluru/Chennai, Palladium, Mall of Asia in Bengaluru, Citadel Indore, Lucknow and others), with offices, hotels (St. Regis Mumbai, Agra) and a small residential arm. Premium-skewed, annuity-led: operating margin 60%. Management guides 14-15% rental growth through FY28 (scanx 2026-11-04); H1 FY27 retail consumption +28% (Multibagg AI 2026-10-31); Q2 owner profit +7%. Stake in ISMDPL rose to 68.10% after NCLT approval (2026-10-28). Market cap Rs 75,534 cr, P/E 57.

revenue_mix.geography: India metros; ~Mumbai 50%, Bengaluru, Chennai, Pune (model estimate)

exposures.mechanism: Retail malls ~70% of EBITDA (Phoenix Marketcity, Palladium, Mall of Asia, Citadel etc.). +5pp urban consumption -> mall tenant sales +5pp -> turnover-rent (~35% of rental) +1.75% plus faster minimum-guarantee resets and leasing -> rental +2.5% -> EBITDA +2.5% (high flow-through) x EV/MCap 1.1 x persistence 0.8 ~ +2.2, rounded to 2.0. H1 consumption already +28% (Multibagg AI 2026-10-31).

evidence.note: Multibagg AI 2026-10-31: H1 FY27 retail consumption +28%, led by Mall of Asia (Bengaluru); Investing.com call 2026-11-01: retail growth strong
